newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm, cutting demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm, cutting demand.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange slumped to 970 kilos on Friday from Thursday's 1,708 kilos as prices firmed, causing demand to plunge, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at $324.00 an ounce and 1,617,500 lira per gram, compared to $319.50 and 1,588,400 lira at Thursday's close following firmer levels on European markets.
The Turkish lira fell to 154,620 to the dollar versus 154,350 on Thursday, boosting the gold's rise in lira terms.
Almost all of the day's trade -- 930 kilos -- took place in the morning session, with 70.6 percent conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
